execute:
  warning: false
  message: false

## Purpose

Normalize, reduce dimensions, cluster cells, and save embeddings and cluster labels in the Seurat object.

## Packages

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-03-normalization-integration-clustering-packages
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Load only the packages used in this template.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(qs2)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
})
```

## User Config

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-03-normalization-integration-clustering-user-config
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# USER INPUT:
input_object <- "path/to/seurat_qc.qs"
output_object <- "path/to/seurat_clustered.qs"
results_dir <- "results/scrna_clustering"
figures_dir <- "figures/scrna_clustering"
assay_name <- "RNA"
sample_column <- "sample_column"
group_column <- "group_column"
batch_column <- "sample_column"
n_variable_features <- 3000
n_pcs <- 30
cluster_resolution <- 0.5
seed <- 1
n_threads <- 4
compress_level <- 6
```

## Input Loading

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-03-normalization-integration-clustering-input-loading
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Create output folders and load configured inputs.
set.seed(seed)
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
object <- qs2::qs_read(file = input_object, nthreads = n_threads)
DefaultAssay(object) <- assay_name
```

## Validation

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-03-normalization-integration-clustering-validation
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Stop early when required inputs or columns are missing.
stopifnot(inherits(object, "Seurat"))
stopifnot(all(c(sample_column, group_column, batch_column) %in% colnames(object[[]])))
```

## Input Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-03-normalization-integration-clustering-input-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Write a small TSV summary of the loaded input.
readr::write_tsv(tibble::tibble(cells = ncol(object), features = nrow(object)), file.path(results_dir, "normalization_input_summary.tsv"))
```

## Main Analysis

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-03-normalization-integration-clustering-main-analysis
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Run the reusable analysis step for this template.
object <- NormalizeData(object)
object <- FindVariableFeatures(object, nfeatures = n_variable_features)
object <- ScaleData(object, features = VariableFeatures(object))
object <- RunPCA(object, npcs = n_pcs)
object <- FindNeighbors(object, dims = seq_len(n_pcs))
object <- FindClusters(object, resolution = cluster_resolution)
object <- RunUMAP(object, dims = seq_len(n_pcs), reduction.name = "umap")
```

## QC Checks

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-03-normalization-integration-clustering-qc-checks
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export checks that make failures easy to inspect.
cluster_tbl <- object[[]] |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
  count(seurat_clusters, .data[[sample_column]], name = "n_cells")
readr::write_tsv(cluster_tbl, file.path(results_dir, "cluster_counts.tsv"))
```

## Visualization

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-03-normalization-integration-clustering-visualization
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save compact figures for the main outputs.
pdf(file.path(figures_dir, "scrna_umap_clusters.pdf"), width = 6, height = 5)
print(DimPlot(object, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE))
dev.off()
pdf(file.path(figures_dir, "scrna_umap_groups.pdf"), width = 6, height = 5)
print(DimPlot(object, reduction = "umap", group.by = group_column))
dev.off()
```

## Object Result Storage

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-03-normalization-integration-clustering-object-result-storage
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Store reusable analysis metadata inside the object.
object@misc$template <- list(step = "scrna_normalization_integration_clustering", n_pcs = n_pcs, resolution = cluster_resolution)
```

## Result Export

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-03-normalization-integration-clustering-result-export
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export the main reusable tables as TSV files.
readr::write_tsv(object[[]] |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id"), file.path(results_dir, "clustered_metadata.tsv"))
```

## Final Save

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-03-normalization-integration-clustering-final-save
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save the updated object for the next template step.
qs2::qs_save(object, file = output_object, nthreads = n_threads, compress_level = compress_level)
```

## Output Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-03-normalization-integration-clustering-output-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Print a compact summary of generated outputs.
tibble::tibble(output_object = output_object, cells = ncol(object), clusters = length(levels(Idents(object))))
```
